character.name: 黄总
character.en: Mr Huang is careful, numbers-first and politely hard to impress. He speaks short, direct sentences and respects people who stay calm and bring a clear argument. You are selling him a cloud data platform.

goal: Keep the deal alive: acknowledge the price concern, handle the objection, explain usage billing, make the total-cost case, and lock in a next step.

turn2.zh: 另一家公司的报价比你们便宜百分之二十。
turn2.py: lìng yī jiā gōng sī de bào jià bǐ nǐ men pián yi bǎi fēn zhī èr shí .
turn2.en: Another company's quote is 20% cheaper than yours.

twists.prompt: Hidden objection: another vendor quoted 20% less and you suspect Lucas is overpriced. You soften only if he asks what their quote actually includes (support, set-up, limits) instead of just cutting his price.

example.zh: 明白。您那份报价包含哪些服务？
example.py: míng bai . nín nà fèn bào jià bāo hán nǎ xiē fú wù ?
example.en: Understood. What services does that quote include?

twists.en: The budget is frozen until Q3.

turn2.zh: 而且我们今年的预算已经冻结到第三季度了。
turn2.py: ér qiě wǒ men jīn nián de yù suàn yǐ jīng dòng jié dào dì sān jì dù le .
turn2.en: Besides, our budget this year is frozen until the third quarter.

twists.prompt: Hidden objection: this year's budget is frozen until Q3, so you cannot sign a big contract now. You soften only if Lucas offers a phased or smaller start that fits the budget, instead of pushing for the full deal.

example.zh: 明白。预算方面，我们可以分阶段开始，您看行吗？
example.py: míng bai . yù suàn fāng miàn , wǒ men kě yǐ fēn jiē duàn kāi shǐ , nín kàn xíng ma ?
example.en: Understood. On budget, we can start in phases. Would that work?

npc.py: nǐ men de bào jià tài guì le .

hurried.zh: 报价太贵了，我只有五分钟。
hurried.py: bào jià tài guì le , wǒ zhǐ yǒu wǔ fēn zhōng .
hurried.en: The quote is too expensive, and I only have five minutes.

options.zh: 我理解您的顾虑，价格确实不低，不过我们可以算一下总成本。
options.py: wǒ lǐ jiě nín de gù lǜ , jià gé què shí bù dī , bù guò wǒ men kě yǐ suàn yī xià zǒng chéng běn .
options.en: I understand your concern. The price is indeed not low, but we can work out the total cost.
options.why: You agree first, then steer to total cost. Huang Zong feels heard, and the door stays open.

options.zh: 谢谢您的反馈，我们的产品真的很好。
options.py: xiè xie nín de fǎn kuì , wǒ men de chǎn pǐn zhēn de hěn hǎo .
options.en: Thanks for your feedback, our product is really good.
options.why: Polite, but it tiptoes round the price like a cat round a puddle. He still thinks 'expensive'.

options.zh: 一分钱一分货，便宜的东西用不久。
options.py: yī fēn qián yī fēn huò , pián yi de dōng xi yòng bù jiǔ .
w: yī fēn qián yī fēn huò
you get what you pay for
options.en: You get what you pay for, cheap things don't last.
options.why: Probably true, but it sounds like you called his budget cheap. Ouch, in a gentle-ish way.

options.zh: 没问题，我马上给您打八折。
options.py: méi wèn tí , wǒ mǎ shàng gěi nín dǎ bā zhé .
options.en: No problem, I'll give you 20% off right away.
options.why: Instant discount! He now wonders what the old price was hiding. Margin is sad.

intent.en: Acknowledge his concern, agree the price is not low, then pivot with 'but' to looking at total cost.

example.zh: 我理解您的顾虑，价格确实不低，不过我们可以算一下总成本。
example.py: wǒ lǐ jiě nín de gù lǜ , jià gé què shí bù dī , bù guò wǒ men kě yǐ suàn yī xià zǒng chéng běn .
example.en: I understand your concern. The price is indeed not low, but we can work out the total cost.

npc.zh: 另一家公司的报价比你们便宜百分之二十。
npc.py: lìng yī jiā gōng sī de bào jià bǐ nǐ men pián yi bǎi fēn zhī èr shí .
npc.en: Another company's quote is 20% cheaper than yours.

hurried.zh: 别家便宜百分之二十，你们怎么说？
hurried.py: bié jiā pián yi bǎi fēn zhī èr shí , nǐ men zěn me shuō ?
hurried.en: Another firm is 20% cheaper. What do you say?

options.zh: 明白。您那份报价包含哪些服务？预算方面，我们也可以分阶段开始。
options.py: míng bai . nín nà fèn bào jià bāo hán nǎ xiē fú wù ? yù suàn fāng miàn , wǒ men yě kě yǐ fēn jiē duàn kāi shǐ .
options.en: Understood. What services does your other quote include? On budget, we can also start in phases.
options.why: You ask a real question and offer a flexible start. That's a conversation, not a price fight.

options.zh: 我们的服务质量比他们好很多。
options.py: wǒ men de fú wù zhì liàng bǐ tā men hǎo hěn duō .
options.en: Our service quality is a lot better than theirs.
options.why: Maybe, but 'trust me, we're better' is what everyone says. Bring a question, not a slogan.

options.zh: 那您去找他们好了。
options.py: nà nín qù zhǎo tā men hǎo le .
options.en: Then you may as well go with them.
options.why: Dramatic exit, no deal. Even the office plant looks worried.

options.zh: 那我们再便宜一点，您说多少钱？
options.py: nà wǒ men zài pián yi yī diǎn , nín shuō duō shao qián ?
options.en: Then we'll go cheaper. How much do you want?
options.why: You just handed over the steering wheel. He will now drive the price all the way down.

intent.en: Acknowledge, then ask a question or offer a flexible way forward (what their quote includes, or starting in phases).

example.zh: 明白。您那份报价包含哪些服务？预算方面，我们也可以分阶段开始。
example.py: míng bai . nín nà fèn bào jià bāo hán nǎ xiē fú wù ? yù suàn fāng miàn , wǒ men yě kě yǐ fēn jiē duàn kāi shǐ .
example.en: Understood. What services does your other quote include? On budget, we can also start in phases.

npc.zh: 为什么要按用量计费？固定价格不是更简单吗？
npc.py: wèi shén me yào àn yòng liàng jì fèi ? gù dìng jià gé bù shì gèng jiǎn dān ma ?
npc.en: Why bill by usage? Isn't a fixed price simpler?

hurried.zh: 为什么要按用量计费？直接给个固定价格吧。
hurried.py: wèi shén me yào àn yòng liàng jì fèi ? zhí jiē gěi gè gù dìng jià gé ba .
hurried.en: Why bill by usage? Just give me a fixed price.

options.zh: 按用量计费，就是用多少付多少。不用就不收费，不会浪费预算。
options.py: àn yòng liàng jì fèi , jiù shì yòng duō shao fù duō shao . bù yòng jiù bù shōu fèi , bù huì làng fèi yù suàn .
options.en: Usage billing means you pay for what you use. If you don't use it, we don't charge, so no budget is wasted.
options.why: Plain words, one clear benefit. A finance director loves the sound of 'no waste'.

options.zh: 这是我们公司的标准做法。
options.py: zhè shì wǒ men gōng sī de biāo zhǔn zuò fǎ .
options.en: This is our company's standard practice.
options.why: That answers 'how' but not 'why'. He asked why. Gently, he is still asking.

options.zh: 对了，您周末有没有去打高尔夫？
options.py: duì le , nín zhōu mò yǒu méi yǒu qù dǎ gāo ěr fū ?
options.en: By the way, did you play golf this weekend?
options.why: Lovely small talk, wrong moment. He asked about billing, and the golf ball rolls away.

options.zh: 因为固定价格我们会亏本。
options.py: yīn wèi gù dìng jià gé wǒ men huì kuī běn .
options.en: Because with a fixed price we would lose money.
options.why: Honest, but it's all about you. Tell him what he gains, not what you lose.

intent.en: Explain usage billing in simple words: you pay for what you use, and nothing when you don't.

example.zh: 按用量计费，就是用多少付多少。不用的时候就不收费。
example.py: àn yòng liàng jì fèi , jiù shì yòng duō shao fù duō shao . bù yòng de shí hou jiù bù shōu fèi .
example.en: Usage billing means you pay for what you use. When you don't use it, we don't charge.

npc.zh: 总成本真的更低吗？我不太相信。
npc.py: zǒng chéng běn zhēn de gèng dī ma ? wǒ bù tài xiāng xìn .
npc.en: Is the total cost really lower? I'm not so sure.

hurried.zh: 总成本真的更低？别绕圈子，直接给我数字。
hurried.py: zǒng chéng běn zhēn de gèng dī ? bié rào quān zi , zhí jiē gěi wǒ shù zì .
hurried.en: Is the total cost really lower? Don't go round in circles, give me numbers.

options.zh: 我们来算一下：加上维护费，用我们的平台，总成本反而更低。
options.py: wǒ men lái suàn yī xià : jiā shàng wéi hù fèi , yòng wǒ men de píng tái , zǒng chéng běn fǎn ér gèng dī .
options.en: Let's work it out: once you add maintenance, the total cost on our platform is actually lower.
options.why: You invite him to do the sums with you and flip his worry around. Numbers beat adjectives.

options.zh: 相信我，我们的客户都很满意。
options.py: xiāng xìn wǒ , wǒ men de kè hù dōu hěn mǎn yì .
options.en: Trust me, our customers are all very satisfied.
options.why: He said 'not sure' and you said 'trust me'. A finance director hears that as a hug without a receipt.

options.zh: 如果您不信，我们可以再降价。
options.py: rú guǒ nín bù xìn , wǒ men kě yǐ zài jiàng jià .
options.en: If you don't believe it, we can lower the price again.
options.why: Doubt is not a discount code. You just taught him that 'I'm not sure' makes prices fall.

options.zh: 我们下个月有个新功能，很酷的。
options.py: wǒ men xià gè yuè yǒu gè xīn gōng néng , hěn kù de .
options.en: We have a new feature next month, it's really cool.
options.why: Cool feature, wrong question. He asked about cost and got a surprise party.

intent.en: Make the total-cost argument: offer to work out the numbers, and say the total cost is actually lower than he thinks.

example.zh: 我们来算一下：您现在的总成本其实更高，用我们的平台反而更省钱。
example.py: wǒ men lái suàn yī xià : nín xiàn zài de zǒng chéng běn qí shí gèng gāo , yòng wǒ men de píng tái fǎn ér gèng shěng qián .
example.en: Let's work it out: your current total cost is actually higher, and with our platform you save more.

npc.zh: 我还要跟老板商量一下。
npc.py: wǒ hái yào gēn lǎo bǎn shāng liang yī xià .
npc.en: I still need to discuss it with my boss.

hurried.zh: 我还得跟老板商量，你先回去等消息吧。
hurried.py: wǒ hái děi gēn lǎo bǎn shāng liang , nǐ xiān huí qù děng xiāo xi ba .
hurried.en: I still have to discuss it with my boss. Go back and wait for news.

options.zh: 当然。我们先做个试点吧，下周我约个时间，跟您和老板一起看数据。
options.py: dāng rán . wǒ men xiān zuò gè shì diǎn ba , xià zhōu wǒ yuē gè shí jiān , gēn nín hé lǎo bǎn yī qǐ kàn shù jù .
options.en: Of course. Let's do a pilot first. Next week I'll set up a time to look at the data with you and your boss.
options.why: Small step, a date, and the boss in the room. That's how a 'let me think' becomes a yes.

options.zh: 好的，您慢慢考虑，有问题再联系我。
options.py: hǎo de , nín màn màn kǎo lǜ , yǒu wèn tí zài lián xì wǒ .
options.en: Sure, take your time, contact me if you have questions.
options.why: Kind, but the ball is now in his court, wearing a tiny 'forgotten' hat.

options.zh: 那您现在就得告诉我答案。
options.py: nà nín xiàn zài jiù děi gào su wǒ dá àn .
options.en: Then you need to tell me your answer right now.
options.why: Pressure makes people say no just to end the chat. Let's not make him sweat.

options.zh: 不用商量了，我现在就给您最低价。
options.py: bù yòng shāng liang le , wǒ xiàn zài jiù gěi nín zuì dī jià .
options.en: No need to discuss, I'll give you the lowest price now.
options.why: Panic discount at the finish line. The boss will ask for more anyway.

intent.en: Secure a next step: propose a small pilot and set a time next week to meet, ideally with his boss.

example.zh: 当然。我们先做个试点，下周我约个时间，跟您和老板一起看数据。
example.py: dāng rán . wǒ men xiān zuò gè shì diǎn , xià zhōu wǒ yuē gè shí jiān , gēn nín hé lǎo bǎn yī qǐ kàn shù jù .
example.en: Of course. Let's do a pilot first. Next week I'll set up a time to look at the data with you and your boss.
